items.title: Web Performance Optimization
items.description: I audit and fine-tune your website to load faster and feel smoother. From Core Web Vitals to bundle size and image delivery, I turn slow pages into fast experiences that keep users engaged and improve conversions.

items.title: Accessibility & Compliance
items.description: I make your product usable for everyone. By implementing WCAG standards and keyboard and screen reader support, I help you reach a wider audience and meet regulations like the European Accessibility Act.

items.title: Complex Web Applications
items.description: I build scalable dashboards and interactive single-page applications with advanced state management, real-time features, and clean API integration, designed to stay maintainable as your product grows.

items.title: AI-Generated Code Review & Stabilization
items.description: Built a prototype with AI tools? I review, refactor, and harden it for security, structure, and maintainability, turning a quick draft into a reliable, production-ready product.

items.title: Next.js Development & Technical SEO
items.description: I build fast, search-friendly websites with server-side rendering, static generation, structured data, and clean metadata, so your content gets indexed properly and found by the right audience.
